programme.title: Culture Shock S1 E1

programme.title: Culture Shock S1 E2

programme.title: Culture Shock S1 E3

Realizing he’s not better, he and Frans seek help. Meanwhile, Sabrina’s dating app matches fail, sparking interest in Mahesa, a barista at her favorite café.

programme.title: Culture Shock S1 E3
programme.desc: Riko tampil gemilang di babak pertama pertandingan futsalnya, tetapi keadaan menjadi kacau ketika ia terdistraksi oleh para pemandu sorak dengan pakaian terbuka, hingga akhirnya ia muntah mengenai Ilham. Menyadari bahwa kondisinya belum membaik, ia dan Frans pun mencari bantuan. programme.title: Culture Shock S1 E4
programme.desc: After struggling to be honest in the sharing house, Riko turns to a psychologist. He loves the sessions but faces financial hurdles. Meanwhile, Desi wrestles with Bram’s offer to be his second wife, and Sabrina grows closer to Mahesa, ignoring warnings about his underage girlfriend.

programme.title: Culture Shock S1 E4

Sementara itu, Desi bergulat dengan tawaran Bram untuk menjadi istri keduanya, dan Sabrina semakin dekat dengan Mahesa, mengabaikan peringatan tentang pacarnya yang masih di bawah umur.

Meanwhile, Desi meets Bram’s wife and gains her blessing to become his second wife, while Frans finally dates Flo.

programme.title: Culture Shock S1 E5

programme.title: The One S1 E1
programme.desc: One of the SMBG team members suddenly left the team a week before registration for the Fights of Legend professional league closed. Robin and SMBG members (ZEE, ABBY, SACHA, ODRIE) rushed to find new members. Until finally Robin found a replacement for his team member, namely Bara, a former pro-player who had been accused of cheating in matches.

programme.title: The One S1 E1
programme.desc: Salah satu anggota tim SMBG tiba-tiba keluar dari tim seminggu sebelum pendaftaran liga profesional Fights of Legend ditutup. Robin dan anggota SMBG (ZEE, ABBY, SACHA, ODRIE) pun bergegas mencari anggota baru. Hingga akhirnya Robin menemukan pengganti untuk timnya, yaitu Bara, mantan pro player yang pernah dituduh melakukan kecurangan dalam pertandingan.

programme.title: The One S1 E2
programme.desc: There was a division among SMBG members, should they accept Bara or not? Sacha mediated the debate by persuading team members to accept Bara. After being convinced by Robin, Bara was willing to rejoin the SMBG team. However, the SMBG team has not fully united yet, especially since they received news that their registration for the professional league was rejected.

programme.title: The One S1 E2
programme.desc: Terjadi perpecahan di antara anggota SMBG: apakah mereka harus menerima Bara atau tidak? Sacha menengahi perdebatan tersebut dengan membujuk anggota tim agar menerima Bara. Setelah diyakinkan oleh Robin, Bara bersedia bergabung kembali dengan tim SMBG. Namun, tim SMBG belum sepenuhnya bersatu, terlebih setelah mereka menerima kabar bahwa pendaftaran mereka untuk liga profesional ditolak.

programme.title: The One S1 E3
programme.desc: SMBG registration was rejected because of Bara's track record of cheating in professional matches. Zee wants Bara to leave, but Bara's decision to stay is unanimous. The only route the SMBG team can take to enter the professional league is by winning the semi-professional league.

programme.title: The One S1 E3
programme.desc: Pendaftaran SMBG ditolak karena rekam jejak Bara yang pernah melakukan kecurangan dalam pertandingan profesional. Zee ingin Bara keluar, tetapi keputusan Bara untuk tetap bertahan sudah bulat. Satu-satunya jalan bagi tim SMBG untuk masuk ke liga profesional adalah dengan memenangkan liga semi-profesional.

programme.title: The One S1 E4
programme.desc: The SMBG team started to gain popularity because of Bara. Robin also appointed Bara as captain to boost the team's popularity. This creates a tense atmosphere between Bara and Zee. However, the SMBG team continued to win match after match until they advanced to the final round despite these conditions.

programme.title: The One S1 E4
programme.desc: Tim SMBG mulai mendapatkan popularitas berkat Bara. Robin juga menunjuk Bara sebagai kapten untuk meningkatkan popularitas tim. Hal ini menciptakan suasana tegang antara Bara dan Zee. Namun, tim SMBG terus memenangkan pertandingan demi pertandingan hingga akhirnya berhasil melaju ke babak final meskipun dalam kondisi seperti itu.

programme.title: The One S1 E5
programme.desc: The SMBG team received bad news that funds from their investors were blocked for an undetermined amount of time. With their respective strengths, the SMBG team members finally worked together to raise money to support team operations.

programme.title: The One S1 E5
programme.desc: Tim SMBG menerima kabar buruk bahwa dana dari para investor mereka diblokir untuk waktu yang belum ditentukan. Dengan kekuatan masing-masing, para anggota tim SMBG akhirnya bekerja sama untuk mengumpulkan dana guna mendukung operasional tim.

programme.title: The One S1 E6
programme.desc: Zee received an offer from Indra in the form of money and luxury facilities if he wanted to join the Archon team. Zee has not agreed to this, but this makes it difficult for him to concentrate on carrying out activities with the SMBG team, he is often absent because of the distractions given by Indra. This causes a rift within the SMBG team.

programme.title: The One S1 E6
programme.desc: Zee menerima tawaran dari Indra berupa uang dan fasilitas mewah jika ia bersedia bergabung dengan tim Archon. Zee belum menyetujui tawaran tersebut, namun hal itu membuatnya sulit berkonsentrasi menjalani aktivitas bersama tim SMBG. Ia sering absen karena gangguan yang diberikan Indra. Hal ini menyebabkan keretakan di dalam tim SMBG.

programme.title: The One S1 E7
programme.desc: Bara began to reveal signs of Zee's closeness to the Archon team. The entire team was gathered to share all their feelings and problems while joining the SMBG team. Even though it was filled with various loud arguments, in the end they realized that the whole team was a family and had to be united.

programme.title: The One S1 E7
programme.desc: Bara mulai mengungkap tanda-tanda kedekatan Zee dengan tim Archon. Seluruh tim pun dikumpulkan untuk saling berbagi perasaan dan masalah selama bergabung dengan tim SMBG. Meskipun diwarnai berbagai perdebatan sengit, pada akhirnya mereka menyadari bahwa seluruh tim adalah sebuah keluarga dan harus tetap bersatu.

programme.title: The One S1 E8
programme.desc: Robin managed to overcome interference from the Archon team. Now the SMBG team is ready to face the regional final which will make them champions. In the final, it turns out they faced the Archon team.

programme.title: Dunia Maya S1 E2

Her best friend, Kevin, was fully supportive of her new passion and helped her with the content creation process.

programme.title: Dunia Maya S1 E2
programme.desc: Maya mulai mendapatkan lebih banyak perhatian melalui konten DIY kecantikan karena sosok YouTube yang terkenal, Celine, terus me-roasting kontennya. Hal ini membuat Maya semakin viral hingga akhirnya ia bisa mulai memonetisasi kanal YouTube-nya. Sahabatnya, Kevin, sangat mendukung passion barunya dan membantunya dalam proses pembuatan konten.

programme.title: Skripsick S1 E3
programme.desc: Terungkap sudah apa motivasi Bunga berteman dengan Chara. Selain itu, Bunga adalah satu-satunya orang yang mengetahui identitas asli Pak Ganteng. Sementara itu, permusuhan antara Chara dan Robocop semakin memanas — dengan posisinya sebagai mahasiswa, Chara tak berdaya menghadapi dosennya.

programme.title: Ketawa Dimana Aja S1 E3
programme.desc: Ketawa Di mana Aja (Laughter Wherever You Are) is an entertainment program that is presented in the form of a virtual stand up comedy. A host of well-known comedians join the show, among others are Ananta Rispo, Boah Sartika, Indra Frimawan, Indra Jegel, and many more.

programme.title: Ketawa Dimana Aja S1 E3
programme.desc: Ketawa Di Mana Aja (Laughter Wherever You Are) adalah sebuah program hiburan yang disajikan dalam format stand up comedy virtual. Acara ini menghadirkan sejumlah komika ternama sebagai pengisi acara, di antaranya Ananta Rispo, Boah Sartika, Indra Frimawan, Indra Jegel, dan masih banyak lagi.

programme.title: Cinta Di balik Awan S1 E1
programme.desc: Razi, who recently broke up with Jessica, feels there is no point in working hard as a magazine photographer. In the midst of his mental turmoil, Razi meets Jane who offers Razi a side job as a paparazzi. Eventually he accepted the offer, although at first he wanted to withdraw because the risk was too dangerous. Razi then traveled to Yogyakarta with Jane. Formerly, he wanted to help Jane meet a witch to do something on Jane's father's mistress. But the two of them unexpectedly experience an exciting and tense adventure being held hostage by the heretical sect of the Kamilia Divine Kingdom in Gunung Kidul. As a result of being together in the suffering situation, the seeds of love between Razi and Jane start to grow.

programme.title: Cinta Di balik Awan S1 E1
programme.desc: Razi, yang baru saja putus dengan Jessica, merasa tidak ada gunanya bekerja keras sebagai fotografer majalah. Di tengah gejolak batinnya, Razi bertemu Jane yang menawarkan pekerjaan sampingan sebagai paparazi. Akhirnya ia menerima tawaran tersebut, meskipun awalnya ingin mundur karena risikonya terlalu berbahaya. Razi kemudian pergi ke Yogyakarta bersama Jane. Awalnya, ia berniat membantu Jane menemui seorang dukun untuk melakukan sesuatu terhadap selingkuhan ayah Jane. Namun, tanpa diduga keduanya mengalami petualangan seru dan menegangkan saat disandera oleh sekte sesat Kerajaan Ilahi Kamilia di Gunung Kidul. Akibat kebersamaan dalam situasi penuh penderitaan itu, benih-benih cinta antara Razi dan Jane mulai tumbuh.

programme.title: Temen Ngekost S1 E1
programme.desc: When discussions about love language is trending, Rafi tries hard to understand the love language of Yasmin, the girl he that he adores. But his efforts are defeated by Kai, who could immediately understand Yasmin's love language without doing deep observation first.

programme.title: Temen Ngekost S1 E1
programme.desc: Saat sedang maraknya pembahasan love language, Rafi berusaha keras memahami love language Yasmin, perempuan yang disukainya. Tetapi usahanya kalah dengan Kai yang bisa memahami love language Yasmin tanpa mencari tahu dahulu.

programme.title: Kiko
programme.desc: Kiko tells of a child of a goldfish who is very independent, even though he is an only child. Kiko who is always cheerful has four good friends, namely Lola the discus fish, Ting Ting the crab, Patino the catfish and Poli the betta fish. On the other hand, the antagonists, Karkus the catfish and Pupus the eel, always make Kiko's life chaotic. One day, the lake where Kiko lives is polluted due to the reckless acts of humans, causing Kiko and friends to turn into mutants.

programme.title: Kiko
programme.desc: Kiko, seekor anak ikan mas koki yang sangat mandiri, walaupun ia anak tunggal. Kiko selalu riang dan memiliki empat sahabat baik yaitu Lola si ikan diskus, Ting Ting si kepiting, Patino si ikan patin dan Poli si ikan cupang. Di sisi lain, sosok antagonis, Karkus si ikan lele dan Pupus si belut, selalu membuat ricuh kehidupan Kiko.

programme.title: Daur Hidup S1 E4
programme.desc: Sudah 7 tahun sejak Yayas menolak ajakan Dion yang terus memaksanya untuk pulang. Sudah 7 tahun sejak Ibu mengira Yayas telah meninggal. Hingga akhirnya, Yayas memutuskan untuk kembali.

programme.title: Teasing Takagi-San S3, Ep 4
programme.desc: In the Season 3 premiere, Nishikata is determined to finally outsmart Takagi during a series of playful encounters involving grip-strength training, summer tans, and the first days of the new semester. However, Takagi always seems one step ahead, turning every challenge into another opportunity to tease him. Beneath their lighthearted rivalry, both begin to show subtle signs that their relationship is becoming more meaningful, blending comedy, romance, and everyday school life.

programme.title: Teasing Takagi-San S3, Ep 4
programme.desc: Pada episode pembuka musim ketiga, Nishikata kembali berusaha mengalahkan Takagi dalam berbagai tantangan sederhana, mulai dari latihan kekuatan genggaman tangan, membandingkan kulit yang terbakar matahari, hingga momen-momen di awal semester baru. Namun, kecerdikan Takagi selalu membuat Nishikata menjadi sasaran godaan yang menghibur. Di balik persaingan yang penuh canda, keduanya perlahan menunjukkan kedekatan yang semakin berkembang, menghadirkan kisah romantis remaja yang hangat dan penuh humor.

programme.title: Why Raeliana Ended Up..., Ep 12
programme.desc: After her mysterious death, Rinko is reborn as Raeliana-a loved and wealthy character in a novel. But she knows the ending: her murder at the hands of her fiancé. So, she hatches a plan to stay alive, one that involves a devilish duke and a phony engagement.

programme.title: Konosuba, Ep 1
programme.desc: High school student Kazuma Satou dies in an unexpectedly embarrassing accident and awakens in the presence of the goddess Aqua. She offers him the opportunity to be reincarnated in a fantasy world to defeat the Demon King. Before leaving, Kazuma is allowed to take one item with him, and he mischievously chooses Aqua herself. Together, the unlikely pair begin their new life in another world, quickly discovering that surviving there is far more difficult than they imagined. Filled with humor, fantasy, and parody, the episode introduces the eccentric characters and comedic adventures that define the series.

programme.title: Konosuba, Ep 1
programme.desc: High school student Kazuma Satou dies in an unexpectedly embarrassing accident and awakens in the presence of the goddess Aqua. She offers him the opportunity to be reincarnated in a fantasy world to defeat the Demon King. Before leaving, Kazuma is allowed to take one item with him, and he mischievously chooses Aqua herself. Together, the unlikely pair begin their new life in another world, quickly discovering that surviving there is far more difficult than they imagined. Filled with humor, fantasy, and parody, the episode introduces the eccentric characters and comedic adventures that define the series.

programme.title: Konosuba, Ep 1
programme.desc: Kazuma Satou, seorang remaja yang meninggal dalam kecelakaan yang memalukan, bertemu dengan Dewi Aqua di alam setelah kematian. Ia diberi kesempatan untuk bereinkarnasi ke dunia fantasi dan memilih satu benda untuk dibawa. Sebagai balas dendam atas sikap Aqua yang mengejeknya, Kazuma justru memilih sang dewi untuk ikut bersamanya. Setibanya di dunia baru, keduanya segera menyadari bahwa kehidupan sebagai petualang tidak semudah yang dibayangkan. Episode pembuka ini memperkenalkan dunia penuh sihir, monster, dan humor satir yang menjadi ciri khas KonoSuba.

programme.title: Hum Hain Rahi Pyar Ke
programme.desc: Rahul looks after his spoilt nephews, Sunny and Vicky, and niece, Munni. When they go to a funfair, they meet Vyjayanti, who has run away from home, and decide to shelter her without Rahul's consent.

programme.title: Hum Hain Rahi Pyar Ke
programme.desc: Rahul menjaga keponakannya yang manja, Sunny dan Vicky, serta keponakannya, Munni. Ketika mereka pergi ke pasar malam, mereka bertemu Vyjayanti, yang telah melarikan diri dari rumah, dan memutuskan untuk melindunginya tanpa persetujuan Rahul.

programme.title: Pathaan
programme.desc: An Indian agent races against a doomsday clock as a ruthless mercenary, with a bitter vendetta, mounts an apocalyptic attack against the country.

programme.title: Jhanak
programme.desc: Setelah kematian ibunya, Jhanak terpaksa menikahi tunangan sepupunya Arshi, Aniruddh, untuk melarikan diri dari penguntitnya, Tejas. Meskipun Aniruddh dan Arshi telah bersama selama tujuh tahun, Jhanak memasuki kehidupan mereka dalam keadaan yang menyedihkan dan mulai bekerja sebagai pembantu di rumah tangga Bose. Combining endurance, team tactics, and sprint finishes, the tour highlights the highest level of women’s professional cycling throughout the 2026 season.

programme.title: UCI Women's World Tour 2026
programme.desc: UCI Women's World Tour 2026. Ajang balap sepeda jalan raya wanita tertinggi ini menampilkan pembalap kelas dunia dalam berbagai lomba bergengsi di Eropa dan berbagai negara lainnya. Menggabungkan daya tahan, strategi tim, serta adu sprint di garis akhir, kompetisi ini menjadi panggung utama balap sepeda profesional wanita musim 2026.

programme.title: Racing On The Edge S6, Ep 4
programme.desc: Racing On The Edge S6, Ep 4. Go behind the scenes of elite sailing as world-class crews prepare for high-level competition. From tactical decision-making and changing weather conditions to teamwork and precise boat handling, the episode showcases the skill and determination required to succeed in international sailing.

programme.title: Racing On The Edge S6, Ep 4
programme.desc: Racing On The Edge S6, Ep 4. Ikuti kisah di balik layar dunia olahraga layar saat para kru terbaik mempersiapkan diri menghadapi kompetisi internasional. Episode ini menampilkan strategi menghadapi perubahan cuaca, kerja sama tim, serta keterampilan mengendalikan perahu yang menjadi kunci meraih kemenangan di setiap perlombaan.

programme.title: UECL 2025/26: LEG Vs RDI
programme.desc: Leganés face RDI in a UEFA Europa Conference League 2025/26 match played in Spain. With progression at stake, both sides focus on tactical control, patience, and capitalizing on key moments.

programme.title: UECL 2025/26: LEG Vs RDI
programme.desc: Leganés menghadapi RDI dalam laga UEFA Europa Conference League 2025/26 di Spanyol. Demi kelolosan, kedua tim menitikberatkan kontrol permainan, kesabaran, dan pemanfaatan momen penting.

programme.title: Tales Of Larceny
programme.desc: Li Han Hsiang wrote and directed Tales of Larceny, a story of scams and deceit during the corrupt Chinese Warlord era, featuring top character actors from Shaw Brothers' roster.

programme.title: Tales Of Larceny
programme.desc: Li Han Hsiang menulis dan menyutradarai Tales of Larceny, kisah tentang tipu muslihat dan permainan licik di era panglima perang Tiongkok yang korup, dibintangi aktor-aktor karakter terbaik dari Shaw Brothers.

programme.title: Heaven Sword & Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: In the Yuan Dynasty, martial artists everywhere battle for the Heaven Sword and the Dragon Sabre, as only when these two powerful weapons combine can a secret be revealed to help one become the king of the martial arts world. As Zhang Wu Ji acquires the skills from “Nine Yang Scriptures” by chance, he is also embroiled in this lengthy battle.

programme.title: The Cave Of Silken Web
programme.desc: The 3rd part of Shaw Bros' Journey To The West sees sex and spectacle combine as our heroes are trapped by the seductive 7 Spiders, hellbent on achieving immortality by eating monks!

programme.title: The Cave Of Silken Web
programme.desc: Bagian ke-3 dari film Journey To The West produksi Shaw Brothers ini mengikuti perjuangan para jagoan kita saat dijebak oleh 7 siluman laba-laba penggoda, yang bertekad untuk meraih keabadian dengan memakan para biksu!

programme.title: Demon Of The Lute
programme.desc: The lute-demon Chin Mo has reappeared in the world to wreak havoc. Hsiao Feng-ling is ordered to find a special bow and arrow that can counter the demon.

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: The Shepherd Girl, a heartwarming 1963 musical from Shaw Brothers! In this musical drama, Julie Yeh Feng stars as Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl who falls in love with a handsome boatman named Liu Ta-lung

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: The Shepherd Girl, drama musikal tahun 1963 karya Shaw Brothers! Di film ini, Julie Yeh Feng berperan sebagai Hsiu Hsiu, gadis penggembala cantik yang jatuh cinta pada pelaut tampan bernama Liu Ta-lung.

programme.title: The Black Butterfly
programme.desc: Black Butterfly, steals from the rich and gives to the poor. In reality, she is Bao Zhu, the daughter of retired swordsman Kwan Yee. Trouble starts when a bandit gang who she has robbed come to town looking for her.

programme.title: The Happy Trio
programme.desc: Li Ching, the best actress of her era, play Ah Chiao is a girl from a rural village stranded in the city, who befriends a kind-hearted transient and a retired actor.

programme.title: The Happy Trio
programme.desc: Li Ching aktris terbaik di era nya berperan sebagai Ah Chiao adalah seorang gadis dari desa yang tersesat di kota, yang berteman dengan seorang pemondok yang baik hati dan seorang mantan aktor.

programme.title: Flying Guillotine 2
programme.desc: The emperor's reign of terror expands. Heroic outlaw Ma Teng joins a squad of female rebels, whose leader is torn between family loyalties.

programme.title: Summer Heat
programme.desc: The heavenly Jenny Hu plays the seductive Judy, who juggles three different men: a rich husband, a sexy playboy and sensitive intellectual, in her search for money, sex and love.

programme.title: Summer Heat
programme.desc: Si cantik Jenny Hu berperan sebagai Judy, sang penggoda yang merayu tiga pria berbeda: seorang pria kaya, seorang playboy seksi, dan seorang pria terpelajar nan sensitif dalam pencariannya akan uang, seks dan cinta.

programme.title: The Delightful Forest
programme.desc: Wu Sung, a military swordmaster, is acused of murdering his adulterous sister-in-law and a thug, and sent to exile in Meng Chou. At the prison camp, Shih En, son of the camp commander, intercedes in his favour, to spare him the humiliating 100 bamboo lashes.

programme.title: Woman Of The Night
programme.desc: Three stories of obsession: A voyeur spies on his female roommates, a manager yearns after his secretary and a crippled father shuns his family but then must save his daughter's life.

programme.title: Woman Of The Night
programme.desc: Tiga cerita tentang obsesi: seorang pengintip mengawasi para wanita teman sekamarnya, seorang manajer menyukai sekretarisnya, dan seorang ayah harus menyelamatkan nyawa putrinya meski ia telah mengabaikan keluarganya.

programme.title: The Spiritual Boxer
programme.desc: A con artist uses Kung Fu to swindle villagers for money by pretending to be possessed by angry gods. However, when the villagers are later threatened by bandits he must use the same skills for good.

programme.title: Return Of The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Sequel to the John Lo Mar/Chang Yang original finds immigrant Yeh Feng leaving jail to live with crooked uncle Wang Sha, but his girlfriend Ai Ti has married an abusive husband.

programme.title: Return Of The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Film sekuel ini bercerita tentang imigran Yeh Feng yang kabur dari penjara untuk tinggal bersama paman Wang Sha yang jahat. Namun, ternyata kekasihnya, Ai Ti, telah menikah dengan seorang pria yang kasar.

programme.title: The Lizard
programme.desc: The following content was provided by the publisher: In Shanghai, police are baffled by a cunning thief known as "The Lizard", a modern day Robin Hood who steals from the corrupt upper class and gives to the poor.

programme.title: Invincible Shaolin
programme.desc: Three North Shaolin teachers (Lu Feng, Chang Sheng, and Sun Chien) are called on by the Manchus to teach their soldiers and urged to challenge the current South Shaolin teachers. They defeat the South Shaolin teachers and, that night, the head general (Wang Lung Wei) kills the South Shaolin teachers and blames their deaths on the North Shaolin teachers. The South Shaolin master sends more of his pupils, who are killed accidentally by the North Shaolin teachers. He finally sends two more (Wei Pai and Lo Meng) of his students to train with old masters and trains one student (Kuo Chui) himself with the goal of finally defeating the North Shaolin experts.

programme.title: Invincible Shaolin
programme.desc: Three North Shaolin teachers (Lu Feng, Chang Sheng, and Sun Chien) are called on by the Manchus to teach their soldiers and urged to challenge the current South Shaolin teachers. They defeat the South Shaolin teachers and, that night, the head general (Wang Lung Wei) kills the South Shaolin teachers and blames their deaths on the North Shaolin teachers. He finally sends two more (Wei Pai and Lo Meng) of his students to train with old masters and trains one student (Kuo Chui) himself with the goal of finally defeating the North Shaolin experts.

programme.title: The Pure And The Evil
programme.desc: What began as the sweet reunion of two high school friends quickly deteriorates into a deranged erotic nightmare when Rose takes a shine to former classmate Fang and her new fiance!

programme.title: The Pure And The Evil
programme.desc: Reuni dua teman SMA yang semula manis segera berubah menjadi mimpi buruk erotis yang mengerikan ketika Rose tertarik pada mantan teman sekelasnya, Fang, dan tunangan barunya!

programme.title: The Gambling Syndicate
programme.desc: A provincial detective seeks to take down a local gambling syndicate with the help of two convicts.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: A disgraced former Kung Fu expert makes a living as a merchant with the help of a hot headed friend. When the men are harassed by gangsters, the merchant decided to teach his friend monkey boxing so they can defend their business.

programme.title: Hong Kong 73
programme.desc: Back in 1973 the stock market was skyrocketing, but HK's social issues continued to worsen. TVB and Shaw Bros' biggest stars come together for this ingenious tongue-in-cheek tale.

programme.title: Hong Kong 73
programme.desc: Di tahun 1973, bursa saham meroket, namun masalah-masalah sosial di Hong Kong terus memburuk. Bintang-bintang besar TVB dan Shaw Brothers bersatu dalam kisah yang lucu ini.

programme.title: The Emperor And The Minister
programme.desc: The Emperor Qianlong is not the legitimate successor to the throne at birth, but he only learns the truth when two senior members of a subversive anti-government secret organisation contact him years later.

programme.title: The Emperor And The Minister
programme.desc: Kaisar Qianlong bukanlah penerus takhta yang sah sejak lahir, tetapi ia baru mengetahui kebenarannya saat dua anggota senior organisasi rahasia anti-pemerintah menghubunginya beberapa tahun kemudian.

programme.title: Men From The Monastery
programme.desc: When the "godfather of the kung-fu film" Chang Cheh decided to tell their stories with Alexander Fu Sheng, Chen Kuan-tai, and Chi Kuan-chun in the roles, it was cause for celebration. This film is one of the most beloved in the director's filmography. Each hero is given his own story, when they all come together in a final, day-long battle with hundreds of troops, the effect is unforgettable.

programme.title: The Magnificent Concubine
programme.desc: Yang Gui Fei is the beloved concubine of Emperor. He is besotted with her that he leaves the running of the country to Prime Minister. The Prime Minister is corrupt, causing them to revolt the throne.

programme.title: The Magnificent Concubine
programme.desc: Kaisar tergila-gila pada Yang Gui Fei, selir kesayangannya, sehingga ia menyerahkan pemerintahan negara kepada Perdana Menteri. Namun, Perdana Menteri yang korup, membuat rakyat memberontak.

programme.title: Shaolin Intruders
programme.desc: Shaolin Temple becomes suspect when several clan leaders are robbed and killed by the deadly Shaolin Palm technique.Shaolin Temple becomes suspect when several clan leaders are robbed and killed by the deadly Shaolin Palm technique.

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: Sebuah film yang berkisah tentang sebuah hubungan cinta nan rumit antara sekelompok anak muda yang terjerat dalam ikatan cinta dan emosi.

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Ping and Su are lovers who operate a travel agency specializing in Southeast Asian holidays. Tung, a school mistress, and her students join a guided tour lead by Ping.

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Ping dan Su adalah sepasang kekasih yang mengelola agen perjalanan khusus liburan ke Asia Tenggara. Seorang kepala sekolah bernama Tung beserta murid-muridnya bergabung dalam tur yang dipimpin oleh Ping.

programme.title: Two Con Men
programme.desc: A wonderfully twisted, pseudo-romantic comedy starring Liang Tien and Chang Ying in an age-old competition between rookie con artist versus the ultimate, experienced flimflam man.

programme.title: Two Con Men
programme.desc: Sebuah film komedi romantis yang dibintangi oleh Liang Tien dan Chang Yin, yang berkisah tentang perseteruan lama antara seorang penipu pemula dan seorang penipu yang telah berpengalaman.

programme.title: The Golden Sword
programme.desc: Bai Yu Lung's father mysteriously disappears one night, and for 10 years Bai searches for him in vain. Finally, he decides to head to the far northern part of the country with the hope that he can find a clue in that region.

programme.title: The Golden Sword
programme.desc: Bai Yu Lung's father mysteriously disappears one night, and for 10 years Bai searches for him in vain. Finally, he decides to head to the far northern part of the country with the hope that he can find a clue in that region.

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: In the waning day of the Ching Dynasty, the son of the local magistrate murdered a peddler and raped his wife. The wife had been framed for her husband's murder by the rapist.

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: Pada masa kemunduran Dinasti Ching, putra dari hakim lokal membunuh seorang pedagang keliling dan memperkosa istrinya. Sang istri dijebak atas pembunuhan suaminya oleh sang pemerkosa.

programme.title: Duel For Gold
programme.desc: 6 swordsmen, among them 2 sisters and their husbands, a lone ranger and a security guard, plot, betray and outwit each other for a load of gold.

programme.title: West Chamber
programme.desc: The story is based on a famous Chinese opera. A young impoverished scholar, Zhang, is enchanted by Hong, the daughter of an influential family whom he meets in a temple.

programme.title: West Chamber
programme.desc: Kisah yang diangkat berdasarkan sebuah opera Tiongkok nan terkenal ini menceritakan seorang sarjana muda nan miskin bernama Zhang yang terpesona oleh Hong, putri dari keluarga berpengaruh yang ia temui di sebuah kuil.

programme.title: Death Duel
programme.desc: This martial arts spectacular stars 20-year-old Derek Yee in a great performance as ace swordsman Third Master, who fights evil and saves damsels in distress.

programme.title: Death Duel
programme.desc: Film seni bela diri yang spektakuler ini menampilkan Derek Yee dalam penampilan yang luar biasa, sebagai pendekar pedang Guru ke-Tiga, yang memerangi kejahatan dan menyelamatkan wanita yang mengalami kesulitan.

programme.title: Hong Kong Nocturne
programme.desc: This film showcases the little seen dancing talents of celebrated kung-fu swordswoman Cheng Pei-Pei, as one of three girls dancing their way to the top.

programme.title: Hong Kong Nocturne
programme.desc: Film ini menampilkan bakat tari yang jarang terlihat dari pendekar wanita ternama, Cheng Pei-Pei, yang berperan sebagai salah satu dari tiga gadis yang berjuang mencapai puncak kepopuleran.

programme.title: The Blood Brothers
programme.desc: Assassin Chang and his brother Hung meet up with a soldier, Mu. Together, they form a small mountain army, but when Hung's wife arrives, emotions swell, and Mu leaves for the army. After long, Mu summons his friends to join him, but all the while, he has longed for Hung's wife, and tries to have Hung murdered. This treason forces Hung to take up arms against his former comrade.

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City
programme.desc: The tale of two imperial concubines vying for the emperor's favor.

programme.title: The Enchantress
programme.desc: Max Mok is the dashing young swordsman Feng Xiwu who arrives at a beautiful, but deadly location known as Moonlit Sky to investigate rumors of deaths and disappearances there.

programme.title: Return Of The Dead
programme.desc: Enchanted Shadow is about three stories. A husband and wife that discover they should be careful what they wish for, a naked female ghost seeks revenge and a dead prostitute returns as a ghost in the last tale.

programme.title: Return Of The Dead
programme.desc: Enchanted Shadow terdiri dari tiga kisah. Suami dan istri yang harus berhati-hati dengan apa yang mereka inginkan, hantu perempuan tanpa busana yang ingin balas dendam dan wanita tuna susila yang menjadi hantu.

programme.title: The New One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: A devious martial arts master targets young, talented swordsmen, and makes a wager that whoever loses should cut off their arm, then surprises them with a secret technique they cannot counter. One of his previous victims have had enough.

programme.title: The New One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: Seorang ahli bela diri licik mengincar para pendekar pedang muda berbakat. Ia menantang mereka dengan taruhan bahwa pihak yang kalah harus memotong lengannya sendiri, lalu mengalahkan mereka menggunakan jurus rahasia yang tak mampu mereka tangkis. Namun, salah satu korban terdahulunya memutuskan bahwa sudah saatnya menghentikan semua itu.

programme.title: The Invincible Fist
programme.desc: Here Lo Lieh (future international star of King Boxer) plays a dedicated chief constable for Tsang Chou village, who falls in love with the blind daughter of a bandit who is wreaking havoc.

programme.title: The Delinquent
programme.desc: This film is a coming-of-age tale of the lower-class Hong Kong teens in the 1960s. Wang is the title character, a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side.

programme.title: The Delinquent
programme.desc: Film ini menceritakan kisah tentang para remaja miskin di Hong Kong pada tahun 1960-an. Wang berperan sebagai tokoh utama, seorang remaja pemarah dan pemberontak yang terpikat pada sisi gelap kehidupan.

programme.title: Clan Of The White Lotus
programme.desc: The monk Hung Wen-Ting fights against the evil priest White Lotus.

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter who decides to life in Hong Kong's Kowloon Walled City. He is implicated in the fights and conspiracies. When his friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must save his friend.

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng adalah seorang petarung jalanan yang memutuskan untuk hidup di Kowloon Walled City. Ia terlibat dalam perkelahian dan konspirasi. Saat temannya diburu oleh geng triad, Neng harus menyelamatkan temannya.

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: A Chinese spy who's been out of service for ten years whilst making a living as a butcher is sent to Hong Kong to locate a stolen Tyrannosaurus rex skull.

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: Seorang mata-mata Tiongkok yang telah pensiun selama sepuluh tahun dan mencari nafkah sebagai tukang daging dikirim ke Hong Kong untuk menemukan tengkorak Tyrannosaurus rex yang dicuri.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm

programme.title: Northern Borders
programme.desc: Northern Borders' tells the story of ten year-old Austen Kittredge who is sent by his father to live on his grandparents' Vermont farm, where he experiences wild adventures and uncovers long-festering family secrets. It's 1956 and Austen experiences the farm as a place full of eccentric people, especially his stubborn grandparents whose thorny marriage is known as the Forty Years War. Initially feeling stuck in this fractured household, young Austen plans a quick exit but ends up stranded with no choice but to navigate and endure. A humorous and sometimes startling coming-of-age-story, 'Northern Borders' evokes Vermont's wildness, its sublime beauty, a haunted past, and an aura of enchantment.

programme.title: Northern Borders

Di sana, ia mengalami petualangan liar dan mengungkap rahasia keluarga yang telah lama terpendam. Ceritanya berlatar tahun 1956, dan Austen merasakan pertanian itu sebagai tempat yang penuh dengan orang-orang eksentrik, terutama kakek-neneknya yang keras kepala, yang pernikahan mereka yang penuh masalah dikenal sebagai Perang Empat Puluh Tahun. Awalnya merasa terjebak di rumah tangga yang retak ini, Austen muda berencana untuk segera pergi, tetapi akhirnya terdampar tanpa pilihan selain beradaptasi dan bertahan. Sebuah kisah pendewasaan yang lucu dan terkadang mengejutkan, 'Northern Borders' membangkitkan nuansa liar Vermont, keindahannya yang luar biasa, masa lalu yang kelam, dan aura pesona.

programme.title: MMA 30 S1, Ep 4
programme.desc: Fukuoka, Japan welcomes the top talent in the world of martial arts when Karate 1 Premier League returns. Fukuoka will host athletes from across the globe including last season's Grand Winners such as Hikaru Ono and Ayaka Saito competing in their home country. The World Karate Federation expects another tremendous turnout, featuring Olympic medalists and world-ranked competitors, when the Karate 1 Premier League visits the port city of Fukuoka, Japan, on FIGHT SPORTS.

programme.title: MMA 30 S1, Ep 4
programme.desc: Fukuoka, Jepang akan menyambut para atlet terbaik dalam dunia bela diri saat Karate 1 Premier League kembali digelar. Fukuoka akan menjadi tuan rumah bagi para atlet dari seluruh dunia, termasuk para Juara Umum musim lalu seperti Hikaru Ono dan Ayaka Saito yang akan berlaga di negara asalnya. Federasi Karate Dunia mengharapkan jumlah penonton yang luar biasa, yang menampilkan para peraih medali Olimpiade dan para kompetitor peringkat dunia, saat Karate 1 Premier League mengunjungi kota pelabuhan Fukuoka, Jepang, di FIGHT SPORTS.

programme.title: Greatest Classics S1, Ep 1
programme.desc: Twenty fights into his professional career, highly touted Olympic Gold Medalist Lennox Lewis was taking the steps towards claiming his first World Championship. He had knocked out nearly all of his opponents to this point, and a showdown with nemesis "Razor" Ruddock was just a few months away.

programme.title: Greatest Classics S1, Ep 1
programme.desc: Dua puluh laga dalam karier profesionalnya, peraih medali emas Olimpiade Lennox Lewis mengambil langkah untuk merebut gelar Kejuaraan Dunia pertamanya. Ia telah mencetak KO atas hampir semua lawannya sampai saat ini, dan pertarungan melawan musuh bebuyutannya, "Razor" Ruddock, tinggal beberapa bulan lagi.

programme.title: Knockouts!: Alvarez Vs Cintron
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is Canelo Alvarez taking on Kermit Cintron in a bout that helped elevate Alvarez into the light middleweight title picture and take another step towards becoming one of the biggest names in boxing. Also on the card, action from a classic battle between Joel Casamayor and Michael Katsidis for the WBO Lightweight title.

programme.title: Knockouts!: Alvarez Vs Cintron
programme.desc: Pertandingan utama dalam episode ini adalah Canelo Alvarez melawan Kermit Cintron dalam pertarungan yang telah membantu mengangkat Alvarez ke dalam perebutan gelar juara kelas menengah ringan dan mengambil satu langkah lagi untuk menjadi salah satu nama terbesar dalam dunia tinju. Juga ada dalam kartu pertandingan, aksi dari pertarungan klasik antara Joel Casamayor dan Michael Katsidis untuk memperebutkan gelar WBO Lightweight.

programme.title: Don't Suck
programme.desc: A veteran comedian's last chance at stardom takes him on the road with a young comic who reveals an unexpected past.

programme.title: Don't Suck
programme.desc: Kesempatan terakhir seorang komedian veteran untuk menjadi bintang membawanya ke jalan bersama seorang komedian muda yang mengungkap masa lalu yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Holy Ghost People
programme.desc: Demi menemukan saudarinya, seorang wanita muda menyewa seorang mantan Marinir pecandu alkohol untuk membantunya menyusup ke Gereja Pantekosta One Accord.

programme.title: Intruder
programme.desc: During one of Oregon's most violent storms, a young cellist seeks solitude and comfort in the safety of her large apartment, but soon realizes she might not be home alone.

programme.title: Intruder
programme.desc: Saat Oregon dilanda salah satu badai terparah, seorang pemain selo muda berdiam diri di apartemennya yang luas. Namun kemudian, ia menyadari bahwa sebenarnya ia tidak sendirian.

programme.title: Witches In The Woods
programme.desc: Jill, a tenacious UMass freshman, abandons her studies for an off-the-grid snowboarding trip. When their SUV mysteriously becomes lost, temperatures fall and the group dynamic unravels as a virtual and then literal witch hunt begins.

programme.title: Dead Trigger
programme.desc: A mysterious virus has killed billions and turned many others into bloodthirsty zombies. Unable to stop the virus, the government develops a video game, 'Dead Trigger'.

programme.title: Dead Trigger
programme.desc: Sebuah virus misterius telah membunuh miliaran manusia dan mengubah banyak di antara mereka menjadi zombie haus darah. Pemerintah yang tak mampu menghentikan virus itu menciptakan permainan video 'Dead Trigger'.

programme.title: The Hatching

programme.title: The Hatching
programme.desc: Setelah kematian ayahnya, Tim Webber kembali ke desa asalnya di Sommerset dan menemukan sesuatu nan mengerikan yang mengganggu ketenangan desanya.

programme.desc: Rick Stevens menyukai Nina Pennington. Mereka menjalin persahabatan dan melakukan perjalanan bersama selagi Nina bertengkar dengan pacarnya yang sombong, Kevin.

programme.title: Crime Story
programme.desc: Seorang pria lanjut usia yang menderita kanker, melakukan aksi balas dendam kepada para pencuri yang telah menghancurkan hidupnya.

programme.title: The Bird Catcher
programme.desc: Seorang gadis Yahudi bernama Esther dipaksa untuk menyembunyikan identitas aslinya dengan berpura-pura menjadi anak laki-laki di sebuah peternakan Nazi di Norwegia. Ia pun berencana untuk melarikan diri.

programme.title: After Ever Happy

programme.title: The Professor And The Madman
programme.desc: Kisah Profesor James Murray menyusun kata-kata untuk Kamus Inggris Oxford edisi pertama pada pertengahan abad ke-19.

programme.title: Pionnier 1952
programme.desc: Pionnier 1952 follows an extraordinary investigation inspired by evidence linked to the French Battalion, a unit deployed to the Korean War under the United Nations in 1950. Fighting alongside the U.S. 2nd Infantry Division, the battalion played a crucial role in several major engagements, including the Battle of Arrowhead. Through historical research, battlefield exploration, and personal testimonies, the documentary seeks to uncover the fate of soldiers who never returned, while offering long-awaited answers to the families who have spent decades searching for the truth.

programme.title: Pionnier 1952
programme.desc: Pionnier 1952 mengisahkan sebuah misi investigasi yang berawal dari temuan bukti terkait Batalion Prancis, satuan infanteri yang dikirim ke Perang Korea di bawah naungan Perserikatan Bangsa-Bangsa pada tahun 1950. Setelah bergabung dengan Divisi Infanteri ke-2 Amerika Serikat, batalion ini berperan penting dalam sejumlah pertempuran besar, termasuk Pertempuran Arrowhead. Melalui penelusuran sejarah, eksplorasi medan perang, dan kesaksian berbagai pihak, dokumenter ini berupaya mengungkap nasib para prajurit yang tidak pernah kembali, sekaligus memberikan secercah harapan bagi keluarga mereka yang telah menantikan jawaban selama puluhan tahun.

programme.title: Curse Of Oak Island S12, Ep 25
programme.desc: After a devastating flood disrupted last season's excavation, Rick and Marty Lagina reunite with the Fellowship of the Dig to continue their decades-long search for Oak Island's legendary treasure. Armed with cutting-edge drilling technology, ground-penetrating surveys, and fresh archaeological evidence, the team investigates newly discovered shafts, underground voids, and intriguing artifacts that could finally lead them to the elusive Money Pit. As each discovery raises new questions, Season 12 brings the Fellowship closer than ever to uncovering one of history's greatest unsolved mysteries.

programme.title: Curse Of Oak Island S12, Ep 25
programme.desc: Setelah banjir besar menghambat penggalian pada musim sebelumnya, Rick dan Marty Lagina bersama Fellowship of the Dig kembali melanjutkan pencarian harta karun legendaris Oak Island yang telah berlangsung selama bertahun-tahun. Dengan bantuan teknologi pengeboran mutakhir, pemetaan bawah tanah, dan temuan arkeologi terbaru, mereka menyelidiki poros-poros baru, rongga bawah tanah, serta berbagai artefak yang diyakini dapat mengarah ke Money Pit yang melegenda. Di tengah setiap penemuan yang memunculkan teka-teki baru, musim ini menghadirkan harapan terbesar bagi tim untuk semakin dekat mengungkap salah satu misteri harta karun paling terkenal di dunia.

Armed with cutting-edge drilling technology, ground-penetrating surveys, and fresh archaeological evidence, the team investigates newly discovered shafts, underground voids, and intriguing artifacts that could finally lead them to the elusive Money Pit. As each discovery raises new questions, Season 12 brings the Fellowship closer than ever to uncovering one of history's greatest unsolved mysteries.

programme.title: Curse Of Oak Island S12, Ep 25
programme.desc: Setelah banjir besar menghambat penggalian pada musim sebelumnya, Rick dan Marty Lagina bersama Fellowship of the Dig kembali melanjutkan pencarian harta karun legendaris Oak Island yang telah berlangsung selama bertahun-tahun. Dengan bantuan teknologi pengeboran mutakhir, pemetaan bawah tanah, dan temuan arkeologi terbaru, mereka menyelidiki poros-poros baru, rongga bawah tanah, serta berbagai artefak yang diyakini dapat mengarah ke Money Pit yang melegenda. programme.title: Laluna
programme.desc: La Luna is a beautiful animated short film by Pixar Animation Studios, released in 2011 and directed by Enrico Casarosa. The story follows a young boy on a magical nighttime journey with his father and grandfather, where he discovers the family’s secret job on the Moon.

programme.title: Barbie Dreamtopia

programme.title: Titus The Detective
programme.desc: A mouse-detective with his rabbit and lizard friends in Steamburg. They will jointly expose the crime one of their biggest enemies, a cat named named Bulpan. Starting as a pickpocket, Bulpan works hard to become a very skilled criminal.

programme.title: Titus The Detective
programme.desc: Seorang detektif tikus bersama teman-teman kelinci dan kadalnya di Steamburg. Mereka akan bersama-sama mengungkap kejahatan salah satu musuh terbesar mereka, seekor kucing bernama Bulpan. Berawal dari seorang pencopet, Bulpan bekerja keras hingga menjadi penjahat yang sangat terampil.

programme.title: Yameme
programme.desc: Yan Xiaomei, a kung fu–skilled mayor’s daughter, befriends Dimio, a Western exchange student. Their fantasy adventures blend action, humor, and folklore, celebrating friendship and East–West harmony.

programme.title: Yameme
programme.desc: Yan Xiaomei, pendekar kung fu putri wali kota Dongyan, berteman dengan Dimio, siswa pertukaran Barat. Petualangan fantasi penuh aksi menonjolkan persahabatan dan harmoni budaya Timur-Barat.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew
programme.desc: Rubble goes on paw-some adventures with a whole new crew of pups; the pups use awesome construction vehicles to build and repair things in the town of Builder Cove.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: The misadventures of a talking sea sponge who works at a fast food restaurant, attends a boating school, and lives in an underwater pineapple.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Kesialan spons laut yang bisa berbicara yang bekerja di restoran cepat saji, bersekolah di sekolah perahu, dan tinggal di nanas bawah air.

programme.title: Go Buster
programme.desc: The curious six-year-old Buster, a popular Little Baby Bum character, is a friendly and eager-to-learn yellow bus who takes on new adventures through stories and songs in his own series, Go Buster.

programme.title: Go Buster
programme.desc: Buster berusia enam tahun yang penuh rasa ingin tahu, karakter Little Baby Bum yang populer, adalah bus kuning yang ramah dan bersemangat untuk belajar yang melakukan petualangan baru melalui cerita dan lagu dalam serialnya sendiri, Go Buster.

programme.title: Petualangan Upin & Ipin
programme.desc: A children's animated TV show about Upin and Ipin, five-year-old twin brothers who live with their older sister, Kak Ros, and their grandmother, lovingly called Opa, in the village of Kampung Durian Runtuh.

programme.title: Petualangan Upin & Ipin
programme.desc: Serial televisi animasi kartun anak-anak yang mengisahkan kehidupan Upin & Ipin, sepasang anak laki-laki kembar berusia 5 tahun yang tinggal bersama kakaknya bernama Kak Ros dan neneknya yang biasa dipanggil Opa di Kampung Durian Runtuh.

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: Mila's dad runs the only magic pet store in the city - a fantastical place where you can find all sorts of cute and quirky pets who each have their own unique magic powers, and he has gifted Mila the most magic pet of all, Morphle.

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: Ayah Mila mengelola satu-satunya toko hewan peliharaan ajaib di kota ini - tempat yang fantastis di mana Anda bisa menemukan berbagai macam hewan peliharaan yang lucu dan unik, yang masing-masing memiliki kekuatan sihir yang unik, dan dia telah menghadiahkan hewan peliharaan paling ajaib untuk Mila, yaitu Morphle.

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: The film's story unfolds in the fictional country of Laika and in Hong Kong, China. A police academy student who has not yet graduated, Ashan (played by Gu Bin), is tasked with a dangerous mission. He helps the criminal organization by eliminating obstacles for their leader, Atian (played by An Zhi Jie), in prison. Ashan approaches Atian, gains his trust, and collects evidence against the criminal group. After both of them are released from prison, Ashan assists Atian in rising within the criminal organization in Hong Kong. After enduring numerous challenges, Atian successfully replaces the group's leader, Bao Ge (played by Zeng Zhiwei), becoming the new boss and taking control of the organization. However, just as Ashan is about to complete his mission, his true identity is exposed.

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: The film's story unfolds in the fictional country of Laika and in Hong Kong, China. A police academy student who has not yet graduated, Ashan (played by Gu Bin), is tasked with a dangerous mission. He helps the criminal organization by eliminating obstacles for their leader, Atian (played by An Zhi Jie), in prison. Ashan approaches Atian, gains his trust, and collects evidence against the criminal group. After both of them are released from prison, Ashan assists Atian in rising within the criminal organization in Hong Kong. After enduring numerous challenges, Atian successfully replaces the group's leader, Bao Ge (played by Zeng Zhiwei), becoming the new boss and taking control of the organization. However, just as Ashan is about to complete his mission, his true identity is exposed.

programme.title: KATURI
programme.desc: Katuri is an exciting show about four peacock chicks growing up in a natural forest under the gentle care and affection of Mother Flora. When the peacock chicks encounter difficulties or even danger, Mother Flora is always there to keep them safe.

programme.title: KATURI
programme.desc: Katuri adalah sebuah acara menarik tentang empat anak burung pegar yang tumbuh di hutan alami di bawah perawatan dan kasih sayang lembut ibu flora. Ibu flora selalu mendorong anak-anaknya untuk menjelajahi dunia bersama hewan lain dan membantu mereka kapan pun mereka membutuhkan. Ketika anak-anak burung merak mengalami kesulitan atau bahkan bahaya, ibu flora selalu ada untuk menjaga mereka tetap aman.

programme.title: PORORO, THE LITTLE PENGUIN
programme.desc: Pororo the little penguin and his friends live in a peaceful land covered in snow and ice. They all have different personalities and interests, which sometimes cause a little trouble in their quiet winter world. But together, every day is an adventure where they learn all of life's lessons, big and small!

programme.title: PORORO, THE LITTLE PENGUIN
programme.desc: Pororo si penguin kecil dan teman -temannya tinggal di tanah yang damai yang ditutupi salju dan es. Mereka semua memiliki kepribadian dan minat yang berbeda, yang terkadang menyebabkan sedikit masalah di dunia musim dingin yang tenang. tetapi selalu bersama-sama, setiap hari adalah petualangan di mana mereka belajar semua pelajaran hidup, baik besar maupun kecil !

programme.title: BING
programme.desc: Let's get to know Bing, a cute and curious little rabbit! Together with his beloved adult friend, Flop, Bing always finds exciting new things every day. From playing with bubbles, tying shoelaces, to overcoming sadness, everything becomes a fun adventure! Come on, follow the adventures of Bing and his friends! We can learn many things while laughing, you know!

programme.title: BING
programme.desc: Kenalan yuk sama bing, kelinci kecil yang lucu dan penuh rasa ingin tahu! bersama teman dewasa kesayangannya, flop, bing selalu menemukan hal-hal baru yang seru setiap hari. Dari main gelembung, menali sepatu, sampai mengatasi rasa sedih, semuanya jadi petualangan yang menyenangkan!yuk, ikuti petualangan bing dan teman-temannya! kita bisa belajar banyak hal sambil tertawa, lho!

programme.title: BLUEY
programme.desc: Bluey is an Australian animated series that follows the daily adventures of a six-year-old blue heeler puppy named Bluey. Together with her younger brother, Bingo, and her parents, Bandit and Chilli, Bluey engages in imaginative games that spark curiosity and creativity.

programme.title: BLUEY
programme.desc: Bluey adalah serial animasi asal australia yang mengikuti petualangan sehari-hari seekor anak anjing ras blue heeler berusia enam tahun bernama bluey. Bersama adiknya, bingo, serta kedua orang tuanya, bandit dan chilli, bluey menjalani berbagai permainan imajinatif yang memicu rasa ingin tahu dan kreativitas.

programme.title: TIAN TIAN
programme.desc: A simple family from the big city decides to leave the glitz and glamour of urban life behind and return to the village for the sake of their child, who is afraid to go to school. In the village, they interact with friends, neighbors, and local animals, causing endless awkward and funny situations. However, amid all the silliness, there are also touching moments of togetherness, where laughter and tears go hand in hand. Tiantian, the six-year-old child, full of curiosity and love for the world, begins to develop into a healthy, independent, and confident person amidst the beauty of the countryside.

programme.title: TIAN TIAN
programme.desc: Sebuah keluarga sederhana dari kota besar memutuskan untuk meninggalkan gemerlap perkotaan dan kembali ke desa demi anak mereka yang takut pergi ke sekolah. Namun, di tengah-tengah segala kekonyolan itu, juga terjadi momen kebersamaan yang menyentuh hati, di mana tawa dan air mata berdampingan. programme.title: CIPUNG ABUBU
programme.desc: It all began with the birth of Rayyanza Malik Ahmad (Cipung), the second son of Raffi Ahmad and Nagita Slavina, who brought happiness to everyone, even his cousins Zayn and Zuney. However, unlike Rafathar, the eldest child, he felt jealous because he thought all the attention was being taken by Cipung. Then a miracle happened when fairy dust touched Cipung, Rafathar, Zayn, and Zuney. The fairy dust transformed the babies into magical babies and took them to the world of Boba, a place for children where all miracles can happen and without adults knowing. From that moment on, the adventure began. Together with the Boba, the creatures who work there, they created magical tools and encountered various amazing creatures such as tauge monsters, viruses, zombies, snowmen, and even met Supercool, who heightened the adrenaline of their adventure.

programme.title: CIPUNG ABUBU
programme.desc: Berawal dari lahirnya rayyanza malik ahmad (cipung), putra kedua dari raffi ahmad dan nagita slavina yang membawa kebahagiaan untuk semua orang, bahkan sepupunya zayn dan zuney. Namun, berbeda dengan Rafathar, si anak sulung, dia justru cemburu karena merasa seluruh perhatian diambil oleh cipung. hingga keajaiban terjadi saat Fairy dust mengenai cipung, rafathar, Zayn, dan Zuney. Fairy dust mengubah para bayi menjadi bayi-bayi ajaib dan membawa mereka ke dunia boba, tempat untuk anak-anak di mana semua keajaiban bisa terjadi dan tanpa diketahui orang dewasa. Sejak saat itulah petualangan dimulai. programme.title: RAINBOW BUBBLEGEM
programme.desc: In the underwater world, a mermaid named Purple longs for adventures on land and secretly takes a huge risk by transforming herself into a human. With the help of Pink Star, the sleeping guardian fairy of the bubblegem, Purple transforms. However, the excessive use of magic causes the bubblegem, their source of power, to shatter and scatter across the land. To gather the scattered bubblegems, the sea queen White Gold commands seven mermaids from different sea kingdoms.

programme.title: RAINBOW BUBBLEGEM
programme.desc: Di dunia bawah laut, putri duyung bernama purple merindukan petualangan di daratan dan secara diam-diam mengambil risiko besar dengan mengubah dirinya menjadi manusia. Dengan bantuan pink star, peri penjaga bubblegem yang sedang tertidur, purple berubah wujud. Namun, penggunaan sihir yang berlebihan menyebabkan bubblegem, sumber kekuatan mereka, terpotong dan tersebar di daratan. untuk mengumpulkan kembali bubblegem yang tersebar, ratu laut white gold memerintahkan tujuh putri duyung dari kerajaan laut yang berbeda.

programme.title: SUNNY GIRL NO.23
programme.desc: **SUNNY GIRL NO.23** is not only about the growth journey of a cheerful young girl, but also the first realistic-themed animated series that reflects parent-child education and school life in China. The main character is an 8-year-old elementary school student. She is not extraordinary. She is a clumsy girl, but also energetic, optimistic, and kind-hearted, with a talent for drawing, creativity, and problem-solving abilities that many children can relate to. This animation has been well received by audiences in Mainland China and has also been distributed across Southeast Asia, including Malaysia and Vietnam. The first season expresses a worldview through 26 humorous stories: *"There are many different forms of excellence, and every child is exceptional in their own way."* It not only portrays the childhood experiences of contemporary elementary school students but also explores the clash between traditional and modern parenting concepts. The second season continues and further develops this worldview.

programme.title: SUNNY GIRL NO.23
programme.desc: SUNNY GIRL NO.23 BUKAN HANYA TENTANG PERJALANAN PERTUMBUHAN SEORANG GADIS CERIA, TETAPI JUGA SERIAL ANIMASI BERTEMA REALISTIS PERTAMA YANG MENCERMINKAN PENDIDIKAN ORANGTUA-ANAK DAN KEHIDUPAN SEKOLAH DI TIONGKOK. TOKOH UTAMANYA ADALAH SEORANG SISWA SEKOLAH DASAR BERUSIA 8 TAHUN. DIA TIDAK LUAR BIASA. DIA ADALAH SEORANG GADIS DENGAN KARAKTER CEROBOH TETAPI DIA ADALAH GADIS YANG ENERGIK, OPTIMIS, DAN BAIK HATI YANG BERBAKAT DALAM MENGGAMBAR DENGAN KREATIVITAS DAN MEMILIKI KEMAMPUAN DALAM MEMECAHKAN MASALAH, YANG DAPAT DITEMUKAN OLEH SEBAGIAN BESAR ANAK-ANAK. ANIMASI INI DISUKAI OLEH PENONTON DI TIONGKOK DARATAN, DAN TELAH DIDISTRIBUSIKAN KE ASIA TENGGARA TERMASUK MALAYSIA DAN VIETNAM. MUSIM PERTAMA MENGEKSPRESIKAN PANDANGAN DUNIA DENGAN 26 CERITA LUCU, YAITU "ADA BEGITU BANYAK BENTUK KEUNGGULAN YANG BERBEDA, SETIAP ANAK UNGGUL DENGAN KELEBIHANNYA", TIDAK HANYA MENGHADIRKAN MASA KECIL SISWA SEKOLAH DASAR KONTEMPORER, TETAPI JUGA BENTURAN ANTARA KONSEP PENGASUHAN LAMA DAN BARU. MUSIM KEDUA MEMBAWA DAN MENINGKATKAN PANDANGAN DUNIA INI.

programme.title: NEW KELUARGA SOMAT NEW SEASON
programme.desc: FOLLOW THE EXCITING ADVENTURES OF PAK SOMAT’S FAMILY AS THEY BEGIN A NEW LIFE IN CITEKO! FROM BUILDING BU INAH’S DREAM FOOD STALL, TO THE HILARIOUS UPS AND DOWNS OF LIVING NEXT DOOR TO CEU KOKOM, AND PAK SOMAT’S STRUGGLE TO BECOME AN ONLINE MOTORCYCLE TAXI DRIVER FOR HIS FAMILY. A HEARTWARMING STORY FULL OF LAUGHTER AND MORAL LESSONS FOR ALL AGES.

programme.title: NEW KELUARGA SOMAT NEW SEASON
programme.desc: IKUTI PETUALANGAN SERU KELUARGA PAK SOMAT SAAT MEMULAI HIDUP BARU DI CITEKO! DARI MEMBANGUN WARUNG IMPIAN BU INAH, KEHEBOHAN BERTETANGGA DENGAN CEU KOKOM, HINGGA PERJUANGAN PAK SOMAT MENJADI OJEK ONLINE DEMI KELUARGA. KISAH HANGAT PENUH TAWA DAN PESAN MORAL YANG COCOK UNTUK SEMUA UMUR.

programme.title: POKEMON SEASON 28 HORIZONS - RISING HOPE
programme.desc: Liko and Roy's adventure reaches a whole new level! Joined by their new friend Ult and Roy's Lucario, which can Mega Evolve, they reunite with the Rising Volt Tacklers. Together, the heroes set out to investigate the mystery behind a strange pink mist that is affecting Pokémon across different regions.

programme.title: POKEMON SEASON 28 HORIZONS - RISING HOPE
programme.desc: PETUALANGAN LIKO DAN ROY BERLANJUT KE LEVEL BARU! BERSAMA TEMAN BARU BERNAMA ULT DAN LUCARIO MILIK ROY YANG BISA MEGA EVOLUSI, MEREKA BERSATU KEMBALI DALAM RISING VOLT TACKLERS. KINI, PAHLAWAN KITA HARUS MENYELIDIKI MISTERI KABUT MERAH MUDA ANEH YANG MEMENGARUHI POKÉMON DI BERBAGAI WILAYAH

programme.title: KELUARGA SOMAT
programme.desc: THE SOMAT FAMILY TELLS THAT WE MUST LIVE SIDE BY SIDE AND HELP EACH OTHER AS A COMMUNITY AND AS STUDENTS.

programme.title: KELUARGA SOMAT
programme.desc: KELUARGA SOMAT MENCERITAKAN BAHWA KITA HIDUP HARUS SALING BERDAMPINGAN DAN MEMBANTU SATU SAMA LAIN SEBAGAI MASYARAKAT MAUPUN PELAJAR.

programme.title: PLENTIS KENTUS
programme.desc: PLENTIS KENTUS IS A POPULAR INDONESIAN CHILDREN'S ANIMATION WITH CHEERFUL AND UPbeat SONGS. THEY WERE CREATED AS A FORM OF INNOVATION IN THE CHILDREN'S MUSIC INDUSTRY IN INDONESIA. PLENTIS AND KENTUS ARE TWO BEST FRIENDS WHO ARE STILL IN ELEMENTARY SCHOOL. BOTH HAVE BIG DREAMS TO BECOME FAMOUS SINGERS. THEY LOVE SINGING, COMposing SONGS, AND PERFORMING AT VARIOUS EVENTS. THEIR ADVENTURES ARE FULL OF FUN, FRIENDSHIP, AND OF COURSE, LOTS OF SONGS THAT CAN MAKE CHILDREN SING AND SHOOT.

programme.title: PLENTIS KENTUS
programme.desc: PLENTIS KENTUS ADALAH SEBUAH ANIMASI ANAK-ANAK ASAL INDONESIA YANG POPULER DENGAN LAGU-LAGU CERIA DAN PENUH SEMANGAT. MEREKA DICIPTAKAN SEBAGAI BENTUK INOVASI DALAM INDUSTRI MUSIK ANAK-ANAK DI INDONESIA. PLENTIS DAN KENTUS ADALAH DUA SAHABAT KARIB YANG MASIH DUDUK DI BANGKU SEKOLAH DASAR. KEDUANYA MEMILIKI MIMPI BESAR UNTUK MENJADI PENYANYI TERKENAL. MEREKA SUKA BERNYANYI, MENCIPTAKAN LAGU, DAN TAMPIL DI BERBAGAI ACARA. PETUALANGAN MEREKA PENUH DENGAN KESERUAN, PERSAHABATAN, DAN TENTU SAJA, BANYAK SEKALI LAGU-LAGU YANG BISA MEMBUAT ANAK-ANAK IKUT BERNYANYI DAN BERGOYANG.

programme.title: BEDU DAN ADUL
programme.desc: BEDU AND ADUL IS A 3D ANIMATED FILM SERIAL ABOUT THE ADVENTURES OF CHILDREN IN THE MULTICULTURAL SUBURBS OF JAKARTA. THEIR INQUIRIES MAKE THEM WANTED TO EXPLORE, SOMETIMES CAUSING A FUCKING FUCK.

programme.title: BEDU DAN ADUL
programme.desc: BEDU DAN ADUL ADALAH SEBUAH SERIAL FILM ANIMASI 3D TENTANG PETUALANGAN ANAK-ANAK DI KAWASAN PINGGIRAN JAKARTA YANG MULTIKULTURAL. KARAKTER ANAK YANG SELALU INGIN TAHU MEMBUAT MEREKA INGIN SELALU BEREKSPLORASI HINGGA KADANG MENIMBULKAN KEHEBOHAN

programme.title: MADUN
programme.desc: The Madun series tells the story of Madun (16 years old) and his journey to achieve his dream of becoming a soccer player. His father, Syafei (50 years old), who is of Medan descent, really wants his son to become an Islamic teacher. Because of this, Syafei always hinders Madun's efforts to achieve his dream. For him, Madun only has one choice, which is to become a religious scholar. Madun's mother, Kirana, a native of Batavia, is torn. She must obey her husband, who is anti-soccer. However, on the other hand, she also does not want to prevent Madun from realizing his dreams. She cannot bear to restrain Madun, who loves soccer. However, to realize his dream, Madun faces a lot of competition.

programme.title: MADUN
programme.desc: Serial madun menceritakan perjalanan hidup madun (16 tahun) dalam memperjuangkan cita-citanya menjadi pesepakbola. Ayahnya, syafei (50 tahun) keturunan medan sangat menginginkan anaknya menjadi ustadz. Karena itu. Syafei selalu menghalangi upaya madun mencapai cita-citanya itu. baginya, pilihan madun hanya satu. Yakni jadi ahli agama. Ibunya madun, yaitu kirana asli batavia serba salah, dia harus patuh pada suami anti bola. Namun di sisi lain ia juga tidak ingin menghalangi madun mewujudkan cita-citanya. Ia tak tega mengekang madun yang mencintai bola. Namun untuk mewujudkan mimpinya. madun menghadapi banyak persaingan.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: Oddbods is an animated, slapstick comedy that embraces adventure and celebrates friendship. Following the wacky adventures of eight unique and furry friends, who laugh, play and get up to mischief in their hometown of Oddsville, where even the most ordinary of situations have unexpected outcomes.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Little Angel is an animated musical show for pre-schoolers. The show has been captivating families around the world with its cheeky humor and catchy upbeat songs.

programme.title: COCOMELON IND
programme.desc: With Indonesian-language 3D animations and songs, Cocomelon creates a world centered around the everyday experiences of young children. In addition to helping preschoolers learn letters, numbers, animal sounds, colors, and more, the videos provide lessons in social skills. They give parents the opportunity to teach and play with their children as they watch together.

programme.title: COCOMELON IND
programme.desc: Animasi dan lagu 3d berbahasa indonesia, cocomelon menciptakan dunia yang berpusat pada pengalaman sehari-hari anak kecil. selain membantu anak-anak prasekolah mempelajari huruf, angka, suara binatang, warna, dan banyak lagi. video tersebut memberikan pelajaran kehidupan prososial. memberi orang tua kesempatan untuk mengajar dan bermain dengan anak-anak mereka saat mereka menonton bersama.

programme.title: PORORO AND TAYO SONGS
programme.desc: Watch music videos for Pororo, Tayo, and their friends!

programme.title: PORORO AND TAYO SONGS
programme.desc: Tonton video musik untuk pororo, tayo, dan teman-temannya!

programme.title: NUMBERBLOCKS
programme.desc: Numberblocks is an educational animated series for preschoolers that teaches mathematical concepts through lively, adventurous number block characters. Each number block has its own numerical value and unique personality. They join forces and interact with each other to solve mathematical problems while teaching basic mathematical concepts such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and other concepts. Each episode of “Numberblocks” typically features a short story in which the number blocks work together to complete a task or face a mathematical challenge. Through songs, engaging stories, and bright visuals, the series aims to introduce and reinforce children's understanding of numbers and basic mathematical concepts in a fun and interactive way.

programme.title: NUMBERBLOCKS
programme.desc: Numberblocks adalah serial animasi pendidikan untuk anak-anak prasekolah yang mengajarkan konsep matematika melalui karakter blok angka yang hidup dan berpetualang. Setiap blok angka memiliki nilai numeriknya sendiri dan memiliki kepribadian yang unik. mereka bergabung dan berinteraksi satu sama lain untuk memecahkan masalah matematika sambil mengajarkan konsep dasar matematika seperti penjumlahan, pengurangan, perkalian, pembagian, dan konsep lainnya. Setiap episode dari "numberblocks" biasanya menampilkan cerita pendek di mana blok angka bekerja sama untuk menyelesaikan suatu tugas atau menghadapi tantangan matematika. Melalui lagu-lagu, cerita-cerita yang menarik, dan visual yang cerah, serial ini bertujuan untuk memperkenalkan dan memperkuat pemahaman anak-anak tentang angka dan konsep matematika dasar dengan cara yang menyenangkan dan interaktif.

programme.title: PINKFONG & FRIENDS
programme.desc: Each episode features a new story that is both entertaining and educational, with interactive moments that invite children to guess, sing, and share in the joy with the characters.

programme.title: PINKFONG & FRIENDS
programme.desc: Setiap episode menampilkan kisah baru yang menghibur sekaligus edukatif, dengan momen-interaktif yang mengajak anak menebak, bernyanyi, dan ikut merasakan kegembiraan bersama karakter-karakter tersebut.

programme.title: TAYO, THE LITTLE BUS
programme.desc: In a big city where various vehicles happily coexist, the little bus Tayo has just started learning his route around town. There are many things for Tayo to learn. Tayo and his friends, Rogi, Lani, and Gani, help each other to become great grown-up buses.

programme.title: TAYO, THE LITTLE BUS
programme.desc: Di kota besar di mana berbagai kendaraan dengan senang hati hidup bersama, bus kecil tayo baru saja mulai mempelajari rutenya di kota. Ada banyak hal yang harus dipelajari tayo. tayo dan teman-temannya, rogi, lani dan gani saling membantu untuk menjadi bus dewasa yang hebat.

programme.title: KATURI
programme.desc: Katuri is an exciting show about four peacock chicks growing up in a natural forest under the gentle care and affection of Mother Flora. Mother Flora always encourages her children to explore the world with other animals and helps them whenever they need it. When the peacock chicks encounter difficulties or even danger, Mother Flora is always there to keep them safe.

programme.title: KATURI
programme.desc: Katuri adalah sebuah acara menarik tentang empat anak burung pegar yang tumbuh di hutan alami di bawah perawatan dan kasih sayang lembut ibu flora. Ibu flora selalu mendorong anak-anaknya untuk menjelajahi dunia bersama hewan lain dan membantu mereka kapan pun mereka membutuhkan. Ketika anak-anak burung merak mengalami kesulitan atau bahkan bahaya, ibu flora selalu ada untuk menjaga mereka tetap aman.

programme.title: PORORO, THE LITTLE PENGUIN
programme.desc: Pororo the little penguin and his friends live in a peaceful land covered in snow and ice. They all have different personalities and interests, which sometimes cause a little trouble in their quiet winter world. But together, every day is an adventure where they learn all of life's lessons, big and small!

programme.title: PORORO, THE LITTLE PENGUIN
programme.desc: Pororo si penguin kecil dan teman -temannya tinggal di tanah yang damai yang ditutupi salju dan es. Mereka semua memiliki kepribadian dan minat yang berbeda, yang terkadang menyebabkan sedikit masalah di dunia musim dingin yang tenang. tetapi selalu bersama-sama, setiap hari adalah petualangan di mana mereka belajar semua pelajaran hidup, baik besar maupun kecil !

programme.title: BING
programme.desc: Let's get to know Bing, a cute and curious little rabbit! Together with his beloved adult friend, Flop, Bing always finds exciting new things every day. From playing with bubbles, tying shoelaces, to overcoming sadness, everything becomes a fun adventure! Come on, follow the adventures of Bing and his friends! We can learn many things while laughing, you know!

programme.title: BING
programme.desc: Kenalan yuk sama bing, kelinci kecil yang lucu dan penuh rasa ingin tahu! bersama teman dewasa kesayangannya, flop, bing selalu menemukan hal-hal baru yang seru setiap hari. Dari main gelembung, menali sepatu, sampai mengatasi rasa sedih, semuanya jadi petualangan yang menyenangkan!yuk, ikuti petualangan bing dan teman-temannya! kita bisa belajar banyak hal sambil tertawa, lho!

programme.title: BLUEY
programme.desc: Bluey is an Australian animated series that follows the daily adventures of a six-year-old blue heeler puppy named Bluey. Together with her younger brother, Bingo, and her parents, Bandit and Chilli, Bluey engages in imaginative games that spark curiosity and creativity.

programme.title: BLUEY
programme.desc: Bluey adalah serial animasi asal australia yang mengikuti petualangan sehari-hari seekor anak anjing ras blue heeler berusia enam tahun bernama bluey. Bersama adiknya, bingo, serta kedua orang tuanya, bandit dan chilli, bluey menjalani berbagai permainan imajinatif yang memicu rasa ingin tahu dan kreativitas.

programme.title: TIAN TIAN
programme.desc: A simple family from the big city decides to leave the glitz and glamour of urban life behind and return to the village for the sake of their child, who is afraid to go to school. In the village, they interact with friends, neighbors, and local animals, causing endless awkward and funny situations. However, amid all the silliness, there are also touching moments of togetherness, where laughter and tears go hand in hand. Tiantian, the six-year-old child, full of curiosity and love for the world, begins to develop into a healthy, independent, and confident person amidst the beauty of the countryside.

programme.title: TIAN TIAN
programme.desc: Sebuah keluarga sederhana dari kota besar memutuskan untuk meninggalkan gemerlap perkotaan dan kembali ke desa demi anak mereka yang takut pergi ke sekolah. programme.title: MADUN
programme.desc: The Madun series tells the story of Madun (16 years old) and his journey to achieve his dream of becoming a soccer player. His father, Syafei (50 years old), who is of Medan descent, really wants his son to become an Islamic teacher. Because of this, Syafei always hinders Madun's efforts to achieve his dream. For him, Madun only has one choice, which is to become a religious scholar. Madun's mother, Kirana, a native of Batavia, is torn. She must obey her husband, who is anti-soccer. However, on the other hand, she also does not want to prevent Madun from realizing his dreams. She cannot bear to restrain Madun, who loves soccer. However, to realize his dream, Madun faces a lot of competition.

programme.title: MADUN
programme.desc: Serial madun menceritakan perjalanan hidup madun (16 tahun) dalam memperjuangkan cita-citanya menjadi pesepakbola. Ayahnya, syafei (50 tahun) keturunan medan sangat menginginkan anaknya menjadi ustadz. Karena itu. Syafei selalu menghalangi upaya madun mencapai cita-citanya itu. baginya, pilihan madun hanya satu. Yakni jadi ahli agama. Ibunya madun, yaitu kirana asli batavia serba salah, dia harus patuh pada suami anti bola. Namun di sisi lain ia juga tidak ingin menghalangi madun mewujudkan cita-citanya. Ia tak tega mengekang madun yang mencintai bola. Namun untuk mewujudkan mimpinya. madun menghadapi banyak persaingan.

programme.title: NUMBERBLOCKS
programme.desc: Numberblocks is an educational animated series for preschoolers that teaches mathematical concepts through lively, adventurous number block characters. Each number block has its own numerical value and unique personality. They join forces and interact with each other to solve mathematical problems while teaching basic mathematical concepts such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and other concepts. Each episode of “Numberblocks” typically features a short story in which the number blocks work together to complete a task or face a mathematical challenge. Through songs, engaging stories, and bright visuals, the series aims to introduce and reinforce children's understanding of numbers and basic mathematical concepts in a fun and interactive way.

programme.title: NUMBERBLOCKS
programme.desc: Numberblocks adalah serial animasi pendidikan untuk anak-anak prasekolah yang mengajarkan konsep matematika melalui karakter blok angka yang hidup dan berpetualang. Setiap blok angka memiliki nilai numeriknya sendiri dan memiliki kepribadian yang unik. mereka bergabung dan berinteraksi satu sama lain untuk memecahkan masalah matematika sambil mengajarkan konsep dasar matematika seperti penjumlahan, pengurangan, perkalian, pembagian, dan konsep lainnya. Setiap episode dari "numberblocks" biasanya menampilkan cerita pendek di mana blok angka bekerja sama untuk menyelesaikan suatu tugas atau menghadapi tantangan matematika. Melalui lagu-lagu, cerita-cerita yang menarik, dan visual yang cerah, serial ini bertujuan untuk memperkenalkan dan memperkuat pemahaman anak-anak tentang angka dan konsep matematika dasar dengan cara yang menyenangkan dan interaktif.

programme.title: PINKFONG & FRIENDS
programme.desc: Each episode features a new story that is both entertaining and educational, with interactive moments that invite children to guess, sing, and share in the joy with the characters.

programme.title: PINKFONG & FRIENDS
programme.desc: Setiap episode menampilkan kisah baru yang menghibur sekaligus edukatif, dengan momen-interaktif yang mengajak anak menebak, bernyanyi, dan ikut merasakan kegembiraan bersama karakter-karakter tersebut.

programme.title: TAYO, THE LITTLE BUS

Ibu flora selalu mendorong anak-anaknya untuk menjelajahi dunia bersama hewan lain dan membantu mereka kapan pun mereka membutuhkan. Ketika anak-anak burung merak mengalami kesulitan atau bahkan bahaya, ibu flora selalu ada untuk menjaga mereka tetap aman.

programme.title: PORORO, THE LITTLE PENGUIN
programme.desc: Pororo si penguin kecil dan teman -temannya tinggal di tanah yang damai yang ditutupi salju dan es.
